title: Level 4 (Expert) - D-12
notes:
West leads the ♣J against 4♥. South wins West's club opening lead in hand and should plan to ruff the 4th round of spades (if necessary) in the dummy. In the above layout, South will be sorry if he plays the ♠A and another spade at once.

East will win the second round of spades and cash another spade while West discards his remaining club. The defense will then be able to ruff out South's remaining club honor, leaving South with an inescapable club loser.

South can guard against this danger by cashing his remaining club honor before conceding a spade trick to the defense. The defense can do no better than to return a trump, but South wins and gives up a second spade trick. East is welcome to cash a club trick, but South can win whatever East returns and ruff his spade loser in the dummy.
